about.title: WHO WE ARE
about.heading: UDG Racing Division is the University of Girona's racing team dedicated to innovation in electric motorsport.
about.paragraph1: We are a multidisciplinary team of students and professionals united by a passion for engineering and speed. Each season is a new challenge to overcome technical limits and improve our track performance.
about.paragraph2: We design, build and compete with electric racing vehicles that combine performance, efficiency and sustainability. Our goal is to train the next generation of motorsport engineers while pushing the boundaries of technology.
about.paragraph3: We work in mechanical engineering, electronics, aerodynamics, design and project management. Each member brings their unique skills to create a competitive vehicle that represents UdG's excellence.

questions.question: Who can join the team?
questions.answer: Any motivated UdG student can join. We are looking for profiles in engineering, economics, communication, and more.

questions.question: How can I sponsor the team?
questions.answer: Contact us via the form or by emailing racing@udg.edu. We offer different sponsorship tiers.

questions.question: What competitions do you participate in?
questions.answer: We mainly participate in Formula Student, competing in various international circuits.
